court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, District-Budaun in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.596 of 2022
case_name: Clive F David vs State Of U.P. And Another

parties.respondent_defendant: State of U.P. and another (wife, Family Court)

facts_of_case: The applicant-husband sought to quash an order passed by the trial court rejecting his plea that the marriage was void and no maintenance could be granted.

legal_principles.principle: The salutary remedy under Section 125 Cr.P.C. cannot be subjected to postponement on a determination regarding the validity of marriage.
legal_principles.held: It matters little whether in the ultimate analysis and according to personal law applicable to parties, the marriage is valid or void.
cited_cases: Robin vs. Jasbir Kaur, (2016) SCC OnLine P&H 4033

legal_principles.principle: A marriage between a Hindu and a Christian performed as per the Hindu rites with the full consent of both parties cannot be said to be invalid for purposes of claiming maintenance.
legal_principles.held: The marriage between a Christian and a Hindu performed as per the Hindu rites with the full consent of both parties cannot be said to be invalid for purposes of claiming maintenance u/S. 125, Cr.P.C.
cited_cases: Robin vs. Jasbir Kaur, (2016) SCC OnLine P&H 4033

outcome.final_order: The Court found that the provisions of Section 125 Cr.P.C. are of universal application and are designed to prevent destitution in society, and the question whether the marriage is void or valid under the law applicable to Christians is not much of an issue to be decided in a summary proceeding.

use_for_drafting: advising on maintenance under Section 125 Cr.P.C.
